subject: Request: Temporary attestation addendum to cover post-report controls window
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acetrust.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@acetrust.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for temporary attestation addendum (post-report period)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor risk process we need a short attestation that covers the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date (your report ended 2026-09-30) up to today. The auditor we work with typically accepts a one-page management attestation or a vendor-signed addendum confirming there were no control exceptions and noting any material control changes since the report period.

Specific asks from our side:
- A signed temporary attestation/addendum that states the report period and the current coverage window (2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30).
- A short description of any control changes, incidents, or scope changes in that window.
- Contact for the person the auditor can follow up with if they have questions.

Can you let me know if you can provide this and how long it will take? If you have a standard template or an engineers' evidence index we can deliver to our audit team, that would be helpful.

We may also need the attestation signed in DocuSign (our auditor prefers a signed vendor assertion).

Appreciate a quick timeline — our renewal gate is this Thursday.

Best,
Maya Patel
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
AceTrust Financial

--

- One-page Management Attestation (dates and assertion that no control exceptions affecting SOC 2 criteria occurred during 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30, or transparent statements otherwise).

Can you confirm whether your auditor requires specific wording or a firm template? If yes, please attach. Otherwise we'll use our standard vendor addendum language.

Cc'ing Karthik (security/compliance) and Laura (legal ops) to assemble and sign.

Hi Maya and Simon —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled materials together. Attached is the one-page Temporary Attestation Addendum covering 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30 along with a short evidence index that your audit team can reference. Key points summarized below so your auditor can find them quickly: 

Summary: 
- Attestation: Management asserts that, other than the minor configuration change noted below, there were no control exceptions impacting the covered SOC 2 criteria during 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30.
- Control change: On 2026-10-12 we shortened the automated KMS key rotation window for test environments to improve key isolation. This was a scoped configuration change only and did not affect production key rotation; monitoring and access logging were applied as compensating controls.
- Incidents: No production incidents or security events affecting customer data in the covered window.

Attachments (for auditor):
- Redwood_temp_attestation_addendum_20261130.pdf (one-page attestation, signed by Redwood's Head of Compliance).
- evidence_index_ACETRUST.xlsx (systems in scope, recent change log references, responsible owners).

DocuSign: If your auditor requires a DocuSign-signed copy, please confirm and we'll send immediately. For convenience I included a direct signing link in case you want to complete it now: https://docusign.com/ABC123-signlink

Next steps:
- If the auditor requests any supporting artifacts (config snapshots, KMS rotation logs, or event log excerpts) we can provide redacted exports via a secure share. Please let us know what they need and we'll coordinate delivery and timelines.

If everything looks good we can route the signed attestation today.

Best regards,
